Returned to Members
As a credit union and financial cooperative, BECU doesn't funnel our
profits to shareholders. Instead, we measure our success by how
much money we return to each credit union member through lower
lending rates, higher deposit rates and fewer fees compared to bank
averages.
In 2024, we returned $491.6 million in total to our members — an
